meta.name: minimal-run-and-audit
meta.description: Rigor Run skill for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to capture or normalize evidence from the selected smoke test or documented inference or evaluation command and write standardized `repro_outputs/` files, including patch notes when repository files changed. Do not use for training execution, initial repo intake, generic environment setup, paper lookup, target selection, hidden scientific-meaning changes, or end-to-end orchestration by itself.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑通论文仓库的推理或评估命令,归档成可复核的复现结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有需要复现的深度学习论文仓库,想留下可核查的运行证据
copy.tagline_en: Run a paper repo's documented commands and archive checkable reproduction evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must reproduce a deep-learning paper repo and keep verifiable run evidence

howto.what: 它会执行你选定的 smoke test 或文档里的推理、评估命令,汇总执行结果,并把标准化输出文件写进 repro_outputs/;仓库文件有改动时另写 PATCHES.md 补丁说明。
howto.when: 在复现目标和环境方案已确定,需要为 smoke test 或文档中的推理、评估命令留下执行证据时接管;初始仓库扫描、环境或素材未定、文献查找等场景不适用。

say.text: 跑一下 README 里的推理命令,结果写进 repro_outputs/
say.note: 会执行该命令并生成标准化输出文件

say.text: 执行这个 smoke test,并给我执行结果摘要
say.note: 只做运行与汇报,不启动训练

say.text: 这次运行改了仓库文件,把补丁记到 PATCHES.md
say.note: 记录改动,不掩盖评测相关变更

howto.what_en: It runs the smoke test or the documented inference/evaluation command you picked, summarizes the execution result, and writes standardized files under repro_outputs/; if repo files changed, it also writes PATCHES.md.
howto.when_en: Once a reproduction target and setup plan exist, when you need execution evidence for a smoke test or documented inference/evaluation run. Not for initial scanning, undefined environments, or paper lookup.

say_en.text: Run the README inference command and write the result to repro_outputs/.
say_en.note: Runs it and writes standardized output files

say_en.text: Execute this smoke test and give me an execution result summary.
say_en.note: Run and report only, no training start

say_en.text: This run changed repo files, record the patch in PATCHES.md.
say_en.note: Logs changes, hides no evaluation edits
